user.title: INFP + EMSC earthquake alerts
user.description: INFP alerts come from INCDFP (the Romanian National Institute for Earth Physics) through the Telegram channel “Alertă Cutremur”. Choose a source. **Telegram (INFP)** is the fast one: the INFP bot announces strong earthquakes after ~30 seconds and needs your Telegram account. **EMSC only** needs no account but is slower (1–5 minutes).

menu_options.telegram: Telegram (INFP) + EMSC – fast, needs a Telegram account

telegram.title: Telegram account
telegram.description: Prefer a **separate Telegram account** (another number) subscribed to @INFP_alerteCutremur_bot: the session stored in Home Assistant could read the whole account. Get `api_id` and `api_hash` for free at https://my.telegram.org → *API development tools*. Only messages that look like an INFP bulletin are read.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: Telegram sent a code to the account's app. Enter it here.

password.title: Two-step password
password.description: The account has two-step verification. Enter the password.

phone.title: Telegram phone number
phone.description: Enter the Telegram account's phone number (with country code), **already subscribed, via @INFP_alerteCutremur_bot, to INFP's private alert channels (after accepting their Terms and Conditions)**. Recommended: a separate account (another number), because the session stored in Home Assistant could read the whole account. You will receive a code in Telegram on the next step. Only messages that look like an INFP bulletin are read.

error.code_expired: The code expired. Request a new one.
error.flood: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and retry.

abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different account than the configured one.

init.title: Earthquake alerts
init.description: Choose what to configure. Save everything with “Done”.

general.title: General settings
general.description: Earthquakes below the minimum magnitude or beyond the maximum distance (from the Home Assistant home location) are ignored entirely. The tiers pick from those that pass these thresholds.

tier_1.title: Tier 1
tier_1.description: What happens when an earthquake passes this tier's thresholds. Pick only what you want: anything left empty is skipped. When a magnitude is revised, the alert runs again only if the tier goes up.

notify.name: Phone notifications
notify.description: Pick the phones (Home Assistant app). “Critical” bypasses Do Not Disturb and plays loudly.

data.sound: iOS sound (file name in the app, optional)

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Lights turn on at the chosen brightness and go back as they were on “Seen it”.

speakers.name: Speakers with a spoken message
speakers.description: Pick the speakers and a text-to-speech engine. You can edit the message: the words in curly brackets (magnitude, region, distance, depth, time) are replaced automatically with the earthquake's data.

data.repeat: Repeat siren and voice until “Seen it” (tier 3 only, up to 5 times)

simulate_quake.name: Simulate an earthquake
simulate_quake.description: Fires a simulated earthquake as a DRILL: the matching tier runs with real effects (siren, lights, speakers, phones) but with texts marked “DRILL”. Bypasses thresholds and deduplication.

check_subscriptions.name: Check subscriptions
check_subscriptions.description: Lists the earthquake-alert broadcast channels (by title) the connected Telegram account is subscribed to. Only titles of broadcast channels that look like INFP are read; other chats are not touched.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Stops the alert in progress (sirens, speakers) and puts lights and volumes back as they were.

tier_without_actions.message: Tier {tier} has no actions configured. Choose what happens in Settings → the integration → Configure.
